Name: Games
Definition: Games played

Name: Wins · losses
Definition: All games, including crossover and non-NCAA opponents

Name: Raw offensive rating
Definition: Points scored per 100 possessions, unadjusted

Name: Raw defensive rating
Definition: Points allowed per 100 possessions, unadjusted

Name: Raw tempo
Definition: Possessions per 40 minutes, unadjusted

Name: Possessions
Definition: FGA − OREB + TOV + 0.475 × FTA (a game's possessions average both teams)

Name: Effective field goal %
Definition: (FGM + 0.5 × 3PM) / FGA

Name: Turnover %
Definition: TOV / Poss

Name: Offensive rebound %
Definition: OREB / (OREB + opponent DREB)

Name: Free throw rate
Definition: FTM / FGA

Name: Three-point attempt rate
Definition: 3PA / FGA

Name: Shooting percentages
Definition: Makes / attempts

Name: Assist rate
Definition: AST / FGM

Name: True shooting %
Definition: PTS / (2 × (FGA + 0.44 × FTA))

Name: Opponent
Definition: Prefix: the same stat for the team's opponents (defense)

Name: Site
Definition: H home, A away, N neutral (neutral known for D1 games via ESPN)

Name: Crossover
Definition: 1 when the teams are in different divisions or one is non-NCAA

Name: Quality OK
Definition: 1 when the game passes box-score validation and counts toward ratings

Name: Adjusted efficiency margin
Definition: AdjO − AdjD: points per 100 possessions better than an average team in the division, neutral court

Name: Adjusted offensive efficiency
Definition: Points scored per 100 possessions against an average division opponent

Name: Adjusted defensive efficiency
Definition: Points allowed per 100 possessions against an average division opponent (lower is better)

Name: Adjusted tempo
Definition: Possessions per 40 minutes against an average opponent

Name: Strength of schedule
Definition: Average opponent AdjEM, in-division games

Name: Nonconference SOS
Definition: Average opponent AdjEM, nonconference in-division games

Name: Luck
Definition: Actual wins − the sum of pregame win probabilities (in-division games)

Name: Rank
Definition: Rank by AdjEM within the division; hover for the 80% range

Name: Points per 100 from each factor
Definition: (Team factor − division average) × that factor's regression weight; the eight add up to roughly AdjEM

Name: Watch Score
Definition: 0–100: 35% close game between good teams, 35% style extremes, 30% stakes

Name: Win probability
Definition: Pregame probability from the ratings, frozen before tip

Name: Minutes %
Definition: Minutes / (team minutes ÷ 5)

Name: Offensive rating (Oliver)
Definition: Points produced per 100 possessions used

Name: Usage
Definition: Share of team possessions he uses (FGA, 0.475 × FTA, TOV) while on the floor

Name: Shot share
Definition: Share of team FGA while on the floor

Name: Floor percentage (Oliver)
Definition: Scoring possessions / possessions used

Name: Defensive rebound %
Definition: Share of available defensive rebounds grabbed while on the floor

Name: Assist %
Definition: Share of teammates' FGM he assisted while on the floor

Name: Turnover %
Definition: TOV / (FGA + 0.44 × FTA + TOV)

Name: Block %
Definition: Blocks / opponent 2PA while on the floor

Name: Steal %
Definition: Steals / opponent possessions while on the floor

Name: Fouls committed per 40
Definition: PF × 40 / minutes
